subject: HarborLane ISV integration — tracer & prompt-safety scoping
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@harborlane.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@harborlane.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: HarborLane x Redwood — initial integration intake

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the intro from Vanessa at the summit — excited to explore a tighter integration between HarborLane's conversational analytics and Redwood's serving runtime. High-level ask: we want a first-phase connector that
- sends inference requests to Redwood for text generation and embeddings
- surfaces tracing metadata (span ids, model variant) from Redwood into our event pipeline
- captures prompt-safety signals (toxicity, data-leak flags) returned by Redwood so we can enforce policies downstream

Attached is a short spec that outlines our existing SDK and current telemetry hooks. Can we schedule a 45-minute scoping call next week? Elena (cc) will be the technical lead on our side.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Integrations, HarborLane
--- attachment: harborlane-interop-specs.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@harborlane.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@harborlane.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborLane x Redwood — initial integration intake

Samir — great to hear from you, thanks for the spec.

We can definitely support the flows you describe. Quick notes before the call:
- Tracing: Redwood can emit per-request trace IDs and model variant tags; we usually include these as headers in the response payload for easy stitching.
- Prompt-safety: we offer optional safety hooks that flag categories and confidence scores. We can add structured fields to the JSON response so HarborLane can consume them directly.
- Auth: we support short-lived tokens for backend-to-backend; if you need SSO-based provisioning we can loop in security.

Can you do Thursday 11/12 10:00am PT or Friday 11/13 1:00pm PT? I put Vanessa on copy — she owns partner integrations and can join the scoping call.

Cheers,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
--- referenced: harborlane-interop-specs.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: HarborLane integration — quick pre-call sync

Vanessa / Kim — forwarding HarborLane's ask (attached). They want tracing metadata and prompt-safety signals exposed in the API response and a short connector in their SDK.

Goals for our scoping call with them:
- Confirm response schema for tracing + safety fields (minimal breaking change)
- Decide whether to add a small "telemetry hook" option on the model config (opt-in) or surface as a per-request param
- Estimate engineering effort: prototype connector + 2-week sandbox + 1-week docs & acceptance test

Questions for you:
1) Vanessa — is this within our existing partner SDK playbook or do we need a special SOW?
2) Kim — any constraints on revealing span ids in hosted mode (security/privacy)? I want to be sure we specify token scoping for telemetry ingestion.

I'll join the call with HarborLane tomorrow at 10:00am PT. I put the spec and a quick SSO checklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aB3cExampleDocId

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
--- attachments included: harborlane-interop-specs.pdf, harborlane-sso-requirements.xlsx

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@harborlane.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@harborlane.ai>, CloudRes Partners <partners@cloudres.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HarborLane x Redwood — initial integration intake

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday — that was helpful. Confirming next steps from HarborLane: 
- We want a PoC connector that wires Redwood tracing IDs into our analytics stream and exposes safety tags as optional fields in the generation response.
- Security ask: our compliance team requested the SOC 2 evidence and an example audit log snippet demonstrating model variant and request-id retention for 30 days. Can Redwood share the SOC 2 summary and a sample audit export?
- Timeline: aim for a sandbox prototype by 2027-12-10, then a joint acceptance window the week of 2027-12-20.

Samir / CloudRes — please confirm pricing for a sandbox Dedicated pool (estimate) so we can align procurement.

Elena
Elena Torres
Principal Engineer, HarborLane
